title: She multiplied two 13-digit numbers in 28 seconds. No calculator, no paper.

sources.text: NBC News - 'Human Computer' Shakuntala Devi Dies at 83

caption:
She multiplied two 13-digit numbers in 28 seconds. No calculator, no paper.

In June 1980, Imperial College London's Computer Department verified her multiplying two randomly generated 13-digit numbers correctly in 28 seconds - a feat that entered the 1982 Guinness Book of World Records.

Google marked her 84th birth anniversary with a Doodle in 2013 - recognition that outlasted her lifetime and crossed into how the world remembers Indian mathematical talent.

Her career is a reminder that India's claim to mathematical excellence isn't a recent story - it's one the world has been watching for generations.
